text:
mia-partnerships: Kickoff: we should create a single "playbook" for data-platform connectors (Snowflake, Databricks, Pinecone/Qdrant/Weaviate) to standardize listing, security, and GTM. Short-term goal: a repeatable checklist.
sam-ml: Agree. Playbook should include embedding validation steps, sample datasets, and minimum-latency targets per region. I'll own the eval notebook.
noah-eng: I'll draft connector templates: deployment options (customer-hosted via Terraform, or Redwood-managed), CI tests, and an adapter for differences in vector schema.
rita-marketing: From GTM: need marketplace tile copy for each platform, a 1-paragraph partner FAQ, and a shared press embargo calendar. I can draft copy if you give me bullet points.
omar-legal: Make sure we include language about telemetry retention, BYOK, and disclaimers about third-party marketplace fees. Avoid absolute statements about egress.
kevin-pinecone: Pinecone can provide a co-branded usage example and share best-practice index settings for embeddings. Happy to help with docs.
integration-bot: Created ticket: CONNECTORS-42 "platform connector playbook" assigned to mia-partnerships due 2026-04-10.
mia-partnerships: Action items: Sam -> eval notebook; Noah -> templates + CI; Rita -> GTM copy + embargo calendar; Omar -> contract snippets; Kevin -> index best practices. Weekly sync cadence.
noah-eng: I'll add an example CLI test: `curl -X POST /v1/embeddings -d '{"input":"x"}'` then validate output dims and latency.
sam-ml: Also include qualitative checks for semantic similarity drift across DBs. I'll add a small rubric.
rita-marketing: Will draft the three tile options and circulate tomorrow.
mia-partnerships: Thanks all ":raised_hands:" — I'll send invites and upload the skeleton playbook to the partners repo.
